formula.ascii: Per line of planar length L (sum of vertex-to-vertex distances): samples at d_k = k * spacing for k * spacing < L, plus a last sample at exactly L (a zero-length line gives one sample, an empty line none); p_k interpolates linearly along the segment holding d_k; z_k is the GPURasterSampling rule (bilinear here) at p_k, NaN outside the extent or at nodata; gain sums the positive and loss the negative differences between consecutive finite samples, minimum and maximum cover finite samples. Sums use a fixed reduce-then-scan tree, so float32 rounding differs from a serial sum.
